completed: Audited GITHUB_COMMIT_COMMITTER_TIMESTAMP provenance and confirmed the timestamp is author-controlled commit metadata rather than an independent durable external observation.
Determined ancestry checks alone cannot make a future-dated committer timestamp trustworthy because an ancestor commit can itself carry arbitrary future metadata.
Removed GITHUB_COMMIT_COMMITTER_TIMESTAMP from accepted observation-horizon provenance and explicitly classified it as rejected in policy v2.
Added regression coverage proving even an exact future-dated commit timestamp is rejected while Actions provenance remains accepted.
checkpoint.observation: Commit committer timestamps cannot satisfy the durable external-observation invariant because Git permits the committer date to be author-controlled and future-dated. The safe correction is to reject that provenance class rather than attempt an ancestry-only repair.
